videos.title: Spice things up in Grenada #BestOfTheWorld2027
videos.author: National Geographic
videos.description:
There's more to Grenada than sun, sea, and sand. The rich volcanic soil makes fertile ground for the island's signature spices—nutmeg, mace, and clove—which are woven into the fabric of life here, especially during Spicemas, the country’s vibrant August carnival.
